blocks.title: Adders
blocks.md: A **half adder** adds two bits: **Sum = A XOR B**, **Carry = A AND B**. A **full adder** adds two bits **and a carry-in**: Sum = A XOR B XOR Cin; Carry-out = (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B)). Chaining full adders adds multi-bit binary numbers.

blocks.title: Karnaugh map (K-map)
blocks.md: A K-map arranges a truth table in a grid in which neighbouring cells differ in **one** variable (Gray-code order: 00, 01, 11, 10). Group adjacent 1s in rectangles of 1, 2, 4, 8 (powers of two); bigger groups give simpler terms; groups may overlap and wrap around edges. Each group gives one product term from the variables that **do not change** inside it.

items.text: Half adder: Sum = A XOR B, Carry = A AND B

blocks.caption: A half adder drawn with one XOR gate giving the sum and one AND gate giving the carry.
blocks.alt: Half adder diagram: A and B go to an XOR gate (sum) and an AND gate (carry).

blocks.title: Example
blocks.md: Q = A'BC + ABC + AB'C + ABC' (A' means NOT A). The 1s are at 011, 111, 101, 110, which group as: (B and C), (A and C), (A and B). Simplified: Q = AB + BC + AC. This is the **majority** function: 1 when at least two inputs are 1. Check: A=1,B=1,C=0 gives AB = 1, correct.

blocks.title: Flip-flop
blocks.md: A **flip-flop** is a circuit with two stable states that stores **one bit**. An **SR** flip-flop (two cross-coupled NOR or NAND gates) has Set and Reset inputs; a **D flip-flop** copies its D input on the clock edge. Registers are groups of flip-flops. Sequential circuits depend on stored state as well as inputs.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- K-map rows and columns are in Gray-code order, not 00, 01, 10, 11.
- Groups must be rectangles whose size is a power of two.
- XOR is not OR: 1 + 1 gives sum 0 with carry 1.
- The inputs 'S = R = 1' is forbidden for a simple SR latch.

blocks.title: Example 2 - Full adder
blocks.statement: Find Sum and Carry-out for A = 1, B = 1, Cin = 1.
steps: Sum = 1 XOR 1 XOR 1 = 1. A XOR B = 0, so Carry-out = (1 AND 1) OR (1 AND 0) = 1.
